supersedes: Only ambiguous implementation details; original R01 remains immutable

execution.prepared: Public prepare_native_event_strategy/run_window; optimizer native_prepared_wfo remains off
execution.warmup: LAB indicators prepare on causal historical prefix; engine account begins at registered account start; no shadow decisions or double warmup
execution.sizing: 10 percent of engine context equity at entry decision, units priced at completed decision close; next-open gap changes realized fill notional; report realized allocation separately
execution.sizing_qualification: Decision-time sizing is not claimed identical to fill-time percent equity. Actual engine size_order parity and realized gap exposure are required before economic qualification.

daily_windows.selection: 180 calendar days of eligible data through exact cutoff; canonical Sharpe uses complete UTC days wholly inside that interval, recording omitted partial-day boundaries
daily_windows.decay: 90 complete UTC days per H1/H2/H3 from ceil(selection_ready, UTC day); retain exact ready/activation clocks and alignment delay; require full 270 complete days
daily_windows.justification: Daily UTC Sharpe and a non-midnight ready/cutoff cannot both treat partial boundary days as full daily observations. Explicit alignment prevents a hidden 91-day window.

turnover.registered: absolute fill notional / true engine pre-fill equity
turnover.current_public_callback: NativeFillEvent has no top-level pre_fill_equity field
turnover.diagnostic: pre-bar equity ratio reported under turnover_pre_bar_diagnostic only
turnover.mode4: turnover remains nonfinite internally/null with reason in artifacts; all turnover/trade penalties are disabled in pinned R01 config; no fabricated canonical turnover
turnover.economic_threshold: Do not materialize delta from pre-bar proxy. Require a qualified true pre-fill trace binding or an explicitly preregistered scientific revision before discovery.

model.M0: Train median/MAD standardized mean of g1_rv_6, g1_direction_6, g2_log_activity_30, then train tercile cuts; interpret as a composite descriptor, never universal bull/bear labels
model.state_mapping: one-to-one minimum squared raw-coordinate distance in current train robust scales; best-vs-next permutation cost margin must exceed 0.05; otherwise ambiguous
model.unknown: no state-triggered search; incumbent remains; missing lineage rejected
model.target: real same-engine candidate net mean daily utility, fixed candidate identities known by origin; mature outcome time strictly before supervised fit cutoff

decay_matching.strata: same cell, UTC quarter, declared common economic context
decay_matching.selection: first eligible timestamp per quarter before age outcomes are read

controls.statistical_only: 1000 repetitions per 0, delta, 2delta, 4delta condition; four hypotheses and 4999 bootstrap draws; AR(1) coefficient 0.4 and shared calendar innovation
controls.structural_worlds: NULL_STATIONARY versus RECURRING_OPPORTUNITY, semi-Markov 28-84 day episodes, conditional return AR coefficient +/-0.35
controls.known_effect_limit: A planted market opportunity is not a known learner timing gain of 2delta. Structural full-path controls cannot certify the registered economic-boundary power test without measured end-to-end calibration.

report_rule: No technical PASS, generated world, or configuration boolean substitutes for runtime/economic qualification.
